title: CREATE-008: real OCR engines reachable from the CLI
acceptance: pdfxi create ocr recognizes a real rendered page with the Windows OCR engine (and Tesseract when installed) and writes a searchable PDF whose extracted text contains the recognized words; parser tests cover the TSV and JSON contracts; CREATE-008 becomes verified on the cli host.
notes: ADR 0009 row 9. The Tesseract installer needs elevation on this host; the built-in Windows.Media.Ocr engine supplies a real OCR run on real bytes.
